operation_triplets.scope: Three bytes per operation index; opcode 32 modulo-32 index is skipped before a row read.

source_derived_length_metadata.location: Private static exact-base registry in frame_runtime_callees.c, using sizeof linked arrays; no synthetic native-RVA field.
source_derived_length_metadata.unknown_runtime_pointer: Retains native NUL-terminated read-through behavior and never borrows the former script-id slot length.
source_derived_length_metadata.mutated_known_prefix: Reports incomplete at the measured prefix boundary before an unsupported byte read if its NUL was removed.

native_parser_evidence.pointer_load: 0x2455 loads EBX from [EAX*4+0x4d720] once at entry.
native_parser_evidence.nul_test_and_pointer_step: 0x245c/0x2460 sign-extend and test [EBX], then 0x245f increments EBX; after each command/callback, 0x24b6/0x24ba repeat the byte read/test and 0x24b9 increments EBX.
native_parser_evidence.termination: A zero byte branches to 0x24c1 RET; there is no slot-derived length test in the native loop.
native_parser_evidence.callback_live_width: The command is called at 0x249f; after 0x24d0 returns, 0x24a9 reloads operation[2] into DL and 0x24af adds it to EDI. The current glyph receives the earlier width argument while the next glyph x uses the post-callback byte.
native_parser_evidence.x_advance: Native 0x24af ADD EDI,EDX adds the reloaded operation width; skip path 0x24b3 adds 0x10. Both operate on 32-bit registers and wrap modulo 2^32.
native_parser_evidence.phase_context_reload: After the phase-2 script callback path, 0x1f68 reloads the interface context pointer from 0x70f24 before reading its state byte at +4.
